summary: Iteration 5 complete. Backend: 36/36 pytest passing (added TestCocoaRecordsDateFilter, TestPinLock, and staff-403 assertion on /api/cocoa-rate/live). Frontend: full E2E on preview URL - Owner sees live-rate-card ($5.62/kg from Yahoo cache) with live-rate-change (6%) and live-rate-chart; date-picker filter shows date-filter-note ('Showing deliveries & weighings recorded on 2026-09-18') and clear-date resets; PIN Set dialog rejects wrong account password, mismatched confirm, obvious PINs (1234), and saves on valid input (dialog closes); Lock button shows lock-screen, wrong PIN shows pin-error and stays locked, correct PIN (via on-screen keypad) unlocks WITHOUT re-login (still on /customers, /api/auth/me returns 200 admin); Staff user: live-rate-card hidden, staff-rate-note shown ('Live Global Market — Owner only … Buy cocoa at ₦8,000/kg'), current-rate + payout-input still visible (10kg → ₦80,000), no edit-rate-button, and API /api/cocoa-rate/live returns 403.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 881 lines — still overdue for router split (auth, pin, staff, customers, caretakers, fertilizer, cocoa_records, rate, dashboard).
Live-rate 6h cache is stored under settings._id='cocoa_live' without a TTL index; cache TTL is enforced in the endpoint (fine), but consider a MongoDB TTL index if we ever want automatic eviction.
verify_pin uses the SAME bcrypt hash function as passwords — good — but throttle window is 5min (matches spec); consider adding pin_attempts.locked_until index if attempts collection grows.

PIN lock is a UI-only overlay (LockProvider) — the JWT cookie remains valid, so a determined user with browser dev-tools access could bypass the overlay. This is by design (quick screen lock, not full auth), but should be documented so Chief understands it is not a security boundary.
seed_data_creation: Test staff teststaff_iter5@shop.local was created and deleted during E2E. Owner PIN was set to 739461 during the test and UNSET afterwards (db.users $unset pin_hash + pin_attempts cleared) — verified pin_hash absent post-cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-5 features (owner-only Yahoo live market via GET /api/cocoa-rate/live w/ 403 for staff, cocoa-records ?date=YYYY-MM-DD filter, PIN set + verify with throttle after 5 wrongs, and UI lock/unlock preserving JWT session) verified. Yahoo CC=F reachable from preview env — returned live cached data ($5.62/kg). Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (36 tests). Route note: rate page is /cocoa-rate (not /rate). LockProvider persists locked=true in localStorage — if a run is interrupted mid-lock, subsequent scripts must clear localStorage or the app appears blank on protected routes. No pending bugs.
